resources.string: wuDict reads dictionaries from the shared “Dictionaries” folder (Internal storage ▸ Dictionaries). Choose “Grant access” and allow All files access on the next screen, then copy your .mdx/.mdd, .ifo, .slob, .dsl and .bgl files into that folder.

For a quick test on your own network, not a way to run a server. Other devices can reach the library only while wuDict is open on screen — closing it, or letting the screen turn off, ends it within moments. Sharing is tied to the network the app started on: join a different one and it stops until you reopen the app. While it is on, anything on that network can read your library, with no password. Default: off.
